qualityReasoning:
The three testimonial cards share identical structure and are given a `testimonial-card` class, which signals an attempt at a reusable component pattern — but the class is never actually defined (no `<style>` block, no `@layer components`, no `@apply`). As a result the full long utility-class string (`flex flex-col items-start gap-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm`) is still copy-pasted verbatim on every card, so the dedup promised by the semantic class name isn't realized — it's a dangling, purely decorative hook. This is arguably worse than omitting the class entirely, since it creates false signal that a component abstraction exists.

The theme config itself is minimal and non-redundant (a single `ink` color token, no near-duplicate values), which is good. Markup is otherwise clean, uses semantic alt text, consistent indentation, and reasonable structure for a static three-card grid.

Net: theme config is fine, but the core ask — turning repeated markup into a genuine named/reusable pattern instead of copy-pasted utility strings — was not actually achieved, just gestured at.
